tei:div.tei:p: "!#: rje karma pak+shi zhal gzigs ma'i las byang bzhugs so:

gu ru bud+dha dhārma kā ya na mo: bla ma chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: de yang nyams len bla ma sgrub pa'i tshul: rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ming can des: rang lo nyer lnga lon pa'i sbrul lo la: mgon po rdo rje ber can sgrub pa'i tshe: tho rangs mnal lam ma yin dngos nyams su: mig lam 'od dmar khyug khyug khyim kun khengs: gza' nad na'am cho 'phrul yin nam bsam: cung zad dran med nyid du brgyal nas song: de tshe rang mdun nam mkha'i klong las ni: 'khrul snang mngon snang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong: de yi 'khor gyi bud med gcig gis ni: bdag la lta zhing mdzub mo lha la btsugs: gtso bo'i zhal nas bdag la 'di skad gsungs: sa ma ya: kye ho: rang rig ye shes brjod med ni: zhen pa'i yul ljongs snang ba'i rang mdangs las: 'khrul pa'i gzhi 'byung rig rtsal de rjes 'brang: a 'thas bden 'dzin bag chags lu gu rgyud: sna tshogs snang ba'i cho 'phrul ci yang 'char: gang shar bde sdug bden med snang ba'i yul: de la gcer ltos rang rig gcer bur zhog: snang ba brda yi bla ma snang ba'i yul: gang shar zhen med rang grol e ma ho: de ni gzhi yi sems nyid lta tshul yin: snang ba brda yi bla ma de yin no: de ni sems kyi gnas lugs sgom tshul yin: de nas lam gyi spyod yul sbyong tshul ni: kye ho: ma 'gag sna tshogs 'char ba'i tshe: 'khrul las yid 'phreng gnyis 'dzin re dogs ni: gang shar dug lnga'i rang zhal 'di ltar ltos: nyon mongs rgyu las byung ba'i 'khrul cha 'di: dug gsum 'dod chags bde bar zhen pa'i yid: zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang zla grogs la: a 'thas re dogs med pa'i bya bral gyis: blo 'das klong yangs chen po'i klong du zhog: gang shar ma zhen gang shar rang grol ngang: de la ma yengs dran rig gcer mthong lam: de ni lam gyi sems sbyong tshul yin no: sa ma ya: kye ho: rang rig rang byung 'phro 'du las:

gang shar ma zhen zhen 'dzin spros pa bral: spros bral de yi ngang las nyams snang sbyang: snang ba'i yul stong stong nyid nam mkha'i klong: de dbus blo 'das brjod med ye shes bzhugs: de yang yengs med 'khrul med gcer mthong bzhugs: de la dngos po ma mchis sna tshogs 'phro: 'phro 'du'i byed las rig rtsal rgyu yi lam: byed las gang shar bden med shar grol lam: 'di don rtogs na tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur: sa ma ya: ces gsungs: de ni zhal gdams slad med pa'o: sa ma ya: de la brten nas rang 'dod du brtsams pa: de yi las byang bstan pa ni: dkyil 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng du bla ma'i gtor ma dang: de'i mdun rgyab tu gtor ma zur gsum bdun gyis bskor: sman gtor rak+ta mchod rdzas sna tshogs bshams te: yid gnyis the tshom dang bral bas: bcos min gyi mos gus dang ldan pas bsgrubs na dngos su zhal mthong bar the tshom med do: dngos gzhi las byang ni: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed: bdag mdun bskyed rim: spyan 'dren: phyag 'tshal: bzhugs gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa: skong bshags: bstod pa: gsol gdab: dbang blang sogs: sa bcad bcu po 'di la ma bcos: ma bsre: ma bslad par nyams su len pa gal che: sa ma ya: na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro drug sems can rnams: ngan song sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: bde ldan sangs rgyas thob par shog: rtog tshogs gnyis 'dzin rang sar zhi: rang gsal gcer mthong 'grub gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du: chos 'byung dmar po bsnol ba'i dbus: pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha bye'i steng: chos sku'i rang sgra hūm̐ yig las: grub chen karma pak+shi pa: dmar smug gtum rngam 'bar ba'i sku: spyan rtsa dmar zhing lta stangs 'dril: ag tshom zur gsum nag snum dkyus: zhwa nag gser mdangs dbu la gsol: chos gos rnam gsum sku la bklubs:

rdo rje phur bu phyag na bsnams: rdo rje skyil krung lham mer brjid: pad+ma nyi zla'i khri steng gsal: spyi bor pad+ma 'byung gnas ni: sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs ldan: pad zhwa phod ka chos gos gsol: rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: rdo rje skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: g.yas su ha ya grī wa dmar: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum dmar: spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher: gtum rngam khro bo'i dbang rtags rdzogs: thod dbyug me zhags phyag na bsnams: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs ru dra brdzis: g.yon du rdo rje phag mo dmar: drag gtum khros rngam khro chas rdzogs: spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra ldir: gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams: kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan bcug gar stabs 'gyings: bam ro pad+ma nyi zlar gnas: rgyab tu ras chung rdo rje grags: ras zhwa dkar po rwa gzugs mnabs: yid 'ong mdzes sdug ras gzan gsol: gzugs mdzes yid 'ong lta na sdug: rdo rje dril bu phyag na bsnams: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i cha lugs can: rdor skyil pad+ma nyi zlar gnas: mdun du rdo rje ber nag can: mthing nag khros rngam srin po'i gzugs: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs spyan gsum g.yo: dur khrod chas brgyad khro chas rdzogs: dar nag 'jol ber sku la gsol: zangs gri thod khrag phyag na bsnams: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs log 'dren mnan: rang byung rgyal mo dre 'u zhon: mthing nag khro gtum 'od du 'bar: kha ṭ+wāṃ phur bu me long sbrul: phyag bzhir bsnams shing zhabs btsan skyil: rdo rje legs pa ra skyes 'chib: dmar nag tho ba sbud pa 'dzin: drag gtum sku la dar gos gsol: de ltar snang stong 'od 'bar gsal: bdag mdun bla ma'i dkyil 'khor las: 'od zer phyogs bcur rab 'phros pas: snang srid bla ma phyag rgya che: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ bh+yo tri badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:

hūm̐: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: rigs bdag pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: snang srid chos dbyings dkyil 'khor nas: grub chen karma pak+shi rje: bka' brgyud rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: ras chung rdo rje grags pa ni: grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zla gam dbang drag gzhal yas nas: ha ya grī wa rta mchog dpal: dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: rdo rje phag mo rgyal kun yum: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'og min byang phyogs dur khrod mchog: drag po thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ma hā kā la rdo rje ber: chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mu le mthing gur gzhal yas nas: lha mo rang byung rgyal mo ni: ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'dzam gling dag pa'i yul ljongs nas: dam can rdo rje legs pa che: mched zla sum brgya drug cur bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: snang srid zil gnon lha tshogs rnams: da lta snyigs dus bskal pa la: rnal 'byor bdag la bsrung ba'i phyir: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dir: bdag gis lhang lhang mi 'bod rgyus: bar chad bsal phyir gshegs su gsol: dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: dbang mchog bskur phyir gshegs su gsol: lam sna 'dren phyir gshegs su gsol: thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir gshegs shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ bh+yo tri badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol ma 'dir: pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs: pad+ma nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan: thabs shes dbyer med lhun gyis grub: 'od 'bar brjid ldan lhun chags pa'i: gdan mchog 'di ru bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid dbang sgyur lha tshogs la: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dgyes rdzas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang: bdug spos mar me dri chab dang: zhal zas rol mo na bza' sogs: 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'dis: snang srid 'khor 'das kun bkang ste: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par rol: dgyes rdzas thod chang sngo la dwangs: gur gum sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis sbags: thabs kyi bdud rtsir spel ba 'di: mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par rol: dmar chen rak+ta 'od zer 'bar: shes rab bdud rtsir spel ba 'di: mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par rol: ri rab tsam gyi gtor chen la: dkar thig dmar rgyan brgyan pa 'di: mchod do 'bul lo dgyes par rol: snang srid zil gnon lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam gnyan po bskang gyur cig: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig dang: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnams: nyams gyur thams cad mthol lo bshags: byang dag tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid zil gnon bdud bzhi bcom: skye 'chi med pa 'od kyi sku: 'pho 'gyur med par 'gro don mdzad: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod: de nyid sprul pa'i gnas 'gyur las: dge slong tshul 'dzin he ru ka: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dbang sgyur ba'i: karma pak+shi'i sku la bstod: rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rdo rje: mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin: rdo rje theg pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa: ras chung rdor grags sku la bstod: ha ya grī wa ru dra'i gshed: nga rgyal rnam dag rta gdong ljang: khams gsum dbang sdud sku mdog dmar: dbang chen rta mgrin sku la bstod:

rdo rje phag mos dus mtshan btul: gti mug rnam dag phag zhal nag: rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri thod 'dzin: rdo rje phag mo'i sku la bstod: ma hā kā la rdo rje ber: phrag dog rnam dag khro gtum rngam: dug lnga rtsad gcod zangs gri 'dzin: kun rtog kun 'joms thod khrag rol: rdo rje ber can sku la bstod: bstan srung lha mo rang byung ma: srid gsum lha 'dre'i sde dpon mchog: nyams pa'i srog dbug sdud mdzad mo: rang byung rgyal mo'i sku la bstod: bka' sdod pho nya rdo rje legs: stong gsum sku yi sprul pas gang: glog ltar myur zhing phrin las sgrub: rdo rje legs pa'i sku la bstod: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rang nyid bla mar gsal ba yi: thugs kar 'od kyi thig le'i dbus: pad+ma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor gsum: bkra gsal lham mer gsal ba yi: thugs kar hrīḥl rig sngags bskor: gang bsam phrin las myur 'grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥkarma pak+shi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐: oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ru ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yo dzaḥdza: oṃ badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya wā ka traṃ traṃ shi ni kra ma ni sa ma ya sā dhu tri dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: don sngags byang bstan pa'o: / mdun bskyed bla ma'i lha tshogs thugs ka nas: sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan 'od zer rnams: char ltar babs te rang la sib sib thim: lus gnas rtsa 'khor bzhi po mer gyis gang: dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs gcig car thob par gyur: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: mdun bskyed bla ma rang gi snying gar thim: 'khor rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur: de yang dmigs med blo 'das brjod med ngang: ༈ de nas dbang blang ba ni: khrus dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du song nas: bla ma'i rnam thar brjod: skyabs su 'gro ba:

sems bskyed pa: slob ma lhar bskyed pa: spyan 'dren byin dbab la: slob ma'i mgor rdo rje bzhag la: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: snang ba snod kyi bum pa ru: stong pa bcud kyi bdud rtsis gtams: snang stong bla ma phyag rgya che: gsal stong sku yi dbang thob shog: sngags byang mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: de nas hūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum thogs te: hūm̐: grags stong ma 'gags hūm̐ yig dkar: rig stong rtsal 'byongs hūm̐ yig dmar: gsal stong lhun grub hūm̐ yig mthing: grags stong bla ma phyag rgya che: bla ma'i gsung gi dbang thob shog: sngags byang mthar: wā ka a bhi ṣiñca ā: rdo rje phur bu thogs te: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi thugs rdo rje: sku gsum lhun grub kī la ya: rnam rtog sna tshogs thal bar rlog: ma rig log rtog dbyings su sgrol: bde stong bla ma phyag rgya che: bla ma'i thugs kyi dbang thob shog: sngags byang mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas me long thogs te: hūm̐: rang sems yid bzhin nor bu la: ye shes lnga yi rang mdangs gsal: dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'bras bu smin: yon tan kun 'byung phyag rgya che: bla ma'i yon tan dbang thob shog: sngags byang mthar: rat+na a bhi ṣiñca bh+rūm̐: de nas rgyal mtshan thogs te: hūm̐: kun khyab ye shes rgyal mtshan la: thabs shes dbyer med nyi zlas brgyan: las nyon bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal: 'jigs bral bla med phyag rgya che: bla ma'i phrin las dbang thob shog: sngags byang mthar: karma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: de nas thig le thogs te: hūm̐: bde ba'i nyams kyi nam mkha' la: ye shes lnga yi thig le shar: snang srid bla ma phyag rgya che: brjod med ye shes dbang thob shog: sngags byang mthar: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas sku gzugs thogs te: hūm̐: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: bde stong zung 'jug mkha' dbyings sbyor: gsal stong bla ma phyag rgya che:

rdo rje 'chang gi dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣiñca āḥ cod pan thogs te: hūm̐: ma 'gag mi dmigs dar dpyang ni: glo bur yid byed rlung gis skyod: sna tshogs cho 'phrul rgyan du che: 'gag med shar grol phyag rgya che: gang shar shar grol dbang thob shog: sngags byang sngar ltar: de nas me tog thogs la: hūm̐: snang srid stong pa'i cho 'phrul las: rang rig ye shes me tog bkra: nyon mongs rtog tshogs gang shar rnams: bung bas me tog rtsi len ltar: gang shar bde sdug lam du khyer: re dogs med pa'i dbang thob ste: bya bral chen po'i dbang thob shog: gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba 'di: bla ma'i sku dang gnyis su med: dbang mchog 'di ni bskur ba'i mthus: dngos 'dzin a 'thas 'dun gros kun: sgyu mar shes par byin gyis rlobs: tshe 'di'i rtag brtan 'dun gros rnams: 'khrul par shes par byin gyis rlobs: sngon byung srid pa'i yid lus rgyun: rang ngo 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs: da lta'i sgyu lus gces 'dzin mkhar: 'jig par shes par byin gyis rlobs: cal sgrog rjes 'jug 'chal gtam 'di: brag cha lta bur rtogs gyur cig: rang chas dug lnga'i rlung 'tshubs 'di: ye shes lnga ru rtogs gyur cig: snang srid 'khor 'das zhing khams 'di: rmi lam lta bur rtogs gyur cig: spyir bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: rten sgyu lus dus min 'jig pa'i dus: rang gcig pur bar dor 'khyams pa'i dus: grogs nor rdzas shul du lus pa'i dus: las dge sdig 'bras bu smin pa'i dus: gnas gshin rje'i pho brang mthong ba'i dus: sems 'khrul snang sngangs skrag g.yeng ba'i dus: yid bzod med yi re mug pa'i dus: tshe sngar byas dge sdig dran pa'i dus: thabs gang drag sems la 'phreng ba'i dus: tshe phyi ma'i gnas khang btsal ba'i dus: rang lag stong mchan du bcug pa'i dus:

sems dbang med g.yeng bar 'phyo ba'i dus: pha pad+ma 'byung gnas mthu ma chung: rje karma pak+shi'i thugs rje'i rtsal sprugs shig: 'khor yi dam chos skyong rtsal ma zhan: dus gnas skabs de tsam shar ba'i dus: pha bla ma'i thugs rje ci 'dug blta: bdag ngan song gsum du ma gtang zhig: zhing dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams su: yid skad cig glog 'gyu'i rdzu 'phrul gyis: 'bras phyir mi ldog par gnas gyur cig:

sngags byang mthar: ma hā ba liṃ ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: rgya gram thogs te: hūm̐: skal ldan skyes bu khyod nyid la: rdo rje rgya gram dbang bskur bas: rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag gyur cig: theg pa rim dgu'i rgyas gdab bo: rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med shog: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: rjes maṇ+ḍal la sogs bya'o: yang zab bla ma'i sgrub pa dbang dang bcas pa 'di/ bka' babs kyi rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal gyis brtsams pa'i chos so// sa ma ya/ maṅga laṃ// //
